position: CFTC Administration and Improved Commodities and Derivatives Markets
proposal: The Mandate recommends that Congress amend Section 2 of the Commodity Exchange Act so the CFTC Chairman may remove the agency's Executive Director without a Commission vote. It also recommends setting funding for commissioners' offices by statute, inflation-adjusted, with no budget approval required from the Chairman or administrative staff.
